text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the digital pain that improves with cold, I suspect Raynaud's phenomenon, so do you experience color changes in your fingers (white, blue, then red) when exposed to cold or stress? I would also like to know if you have had any recent weight loss, night sweats, or if you have noticed any lumps in your neck, armpits, or groin.
